faq.q: What is the origin of Alija?
faq.a: Alija is associated with Arabic. Alija is the Bosnian form of Arabic عَلِيّ (ʿAlī), meaning 'exalted'.
Yes — the underlying form عَلِيّ is Arabic.
Alija can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Alija should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ع ل و is Quranic, but ʿAlī is not itself a Quranic personal name.
